text:
anna-support: Heads up — two enterprise customers reporting console usage is missing for ~6 hours. Dashboards show flat lines since ~03:00 UTC.

michael-cs: Confirmed from tickets #12345 and #12346. They say API calls succeed but console graphs are zero.

anna-support: Assigning to eng-analytics. @tom-analytics can you triage?

tom-analytics: Looking now. Quick check: kafka consumer `hourly-rollups` shows consumer lag ~4.2M. Rollup writer logs showing repeated write failures.

sara-engineering: I see a schema migration for hourly_rollups ran at 02:50 UTC (added composite key change). Consumer version at that time might not include tenant_id in writes.

etl-bot: alert: consumer:error duplicate_key spikes at 03:05 UTC -> 04:40 UTC.

deploy-bot: deploy:etl-rollup-consumer v2.4.1 -> started at 04:12 UTC

tom-analytics: Stack snippet: `psql ERROR: duplicate key value violates unique constraint "hourly_rollups_pkey" at rollup_writer.go:87` — consumer retries then backs off, explains lag.

anna-support: Any impact to billing?

michael-cs: Billing pipeline uses raw events and is unaffected. This is only aggregate/console visibility.

sara-engineering: Quick mitigation: restart consumer with migration flag to include new key shape, then run backfill for the gap window (03:00-09:00). I'll take it.

tom-analytics: Backfill command I'm preparing: `./scripts/backfill_rollups --from 2026-03-15T03:00Z --to 2026-03-15T09:00Z --parallel 8`

anna-support: Notifying customers with ETA 45-60m. Will update them as we make progress.

sara-engineering: Kicking off backfill now. Monitoring: write-rate to hourly_rollups increasing. Estimated backfill ~30-40m depending on parallelism.

tom-analytics: Root cause: migration added tenant_id to composite primary key but the consumer was still writing the old key tuple -> duplicate key errors. Hotfix required before backfill to avoid inconsistencies.

deply-bot: (typo)

deply-bot: job: backfill_rollups (id: bf-20260315-01) started.

sara-engineering: Hotfix patch deployed to consumer at 05:02 UTC, rolling restarts. Consumer now writes tenant_id field. No more dup errors in fresh writes.

tom-analytics: Backfill progress: processed 100k of 800k windows, dup errors gone, consumer lag dropping.

anna-support: Updated customer: dashboards should repopulate within ~1h. Gave workaround to view raw usage endpoints.

michael-cs: Marking incident as support:partial-impact and creating follow-up ticket for postmortem and SLA notes.

sara-engineering: Postmortem action items: add schema-validation to the consumer, add canary check for partition/key changes, add alert for duplicate-key spikes and consumer lag > 500k. Also add a pre-migration compatibility test.

tom-analytics: Ops helper query logs: `SELECT count(*) FROM hourly_rollups WHERE ts >= '2026-03-15 03:00:00' AND tenant = 'acme'` returned 0 before backfill, now returning rows as backfill progresses.

anna-support: :thumbsup: thanks team — keep updates here until backfill finishes.

etl-bot: backfill job bf-20260315-01 ETA update: ~18m remaining.
